description:
Mixed Brands
Smoking Pipe Collection with Carousel Rack and Humidor Jar
Vintage, Mixed Materials including Briar, Metal, and Glass
This comprehensive tobacco enthusiast's lot includes seven varied smoking pipes and a classic wooden carousel-style storage rack. The collection showcases a diverse range of pipe-making traditions, from the industrial aesthetic of the metal-stemmed Viking pipe to rustic, hand-carved artisan pieces and a highly detailed figural bowl featuring a carved bearded head. The centerpiece is a tiered wooden carousel that holds up to 12 pipes and features a central glass humidor jar for tobacco preservation.

Wooden Carousel Rack: Two-tier walnut-toned wood construction with a ribbed glass humidor jar and matching wooden lid

The wooden carousel shows minor surface scuffing and finish wear consistent with age. The glass humidor jar is free of chips or cracks. The Viking metal stem shows light surface pitting typical of vintage chrome-plated components.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage

These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height

description:
Mixed Mineral & Artifact Collection
Various Gemstones, Minerals, and Lithic Points
Assorted Dimensions
Unsigned / Ancient
This comprehensive lapidary and mineral collection features a diverse array of natural specimens, carved decorative objects, and ancient lithic artifacts. The lot includes six significant chert or flint projectile points (arrowheads) exhibiting characteristic knapping and varied patinas. description:
Natural History Specimen
Four Polished Petrified Wood Slices
Fossilized Wood and Mineralized Silica
Approximately 16" x 12" x 11" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This collection of four polished petrified wood slices showcases the intricate process of permineralization, where organic wood fibers are replaced by minerals over millions of years while retaining the original cellular structure. Each specimen displays distinct annual growth rings and vibrant color variations ranging from deep onyx blacks to warm ochre and cream, typical of ancient coniferous or hardwood species. The faces have been polished to a high luster, revealing crystalline structures and unique geological signatures, while the perimeters retain the rugged, natural texture of fossilized bark.
Professionally polished faces highlighting internal mineral structures and growth patterns
Natural rough-hewn edges providing a stark contrast between raw earth and refined surface
Substantial total weight of 24 pounds suitable for architectural display or specimen collection
Condition:
Very good condition with stable mineral structures. As natural specimens, these pieces exhibit inherent fissures, inclusions, and voids characteristic of the fossilization process. Surfaces are polished to a high gloss with minimal abrasions and the specimens remain structurally sound.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

description:
Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Together, these pieces provide a compelling study of mineral growth and make for excellent decorative display pieces or additions to a rock and mineral collection.
Total combined weight of 3.1 lbs as confirmed by digital scale measurement
One specimen features a distinct amethyst cluster with lavender-hued points and visible agate banding
Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging
Largest specimen measures approximately 5.5 inches in length based on visual scale
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.

Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Art Glass, Agate, and Burl Wood
10" x 4" x 5"

This intricate mixed media sculpture by artist John P. Koehler captures a stylized natural scene through a sophisticated combination of organic and artisanal materials. The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. The composition reflects the studio glass movement of the late 20th century, emphasizing the contrast between the translucent, fragile nature of glass and the raw, earthy textures of stone and wood.
Features two distinct gold-flecked blown glass cattails and multiple slender glass reeds

The set includes a beautifully crafted woodgrain rack with space for up to six pipes, alongside a classic barrel-shaped humidor designed to keep your tobacco fresh. The rich brown wooden construction provides both durability and a handsome display, complemented by a soft felted base with an original Decatur Industries sticker for added vintage appeal. Visible signs of age include scratches and a noticeable split on the humidor's side, as well as typical wear on the pipes, which speaks to its authentic vintage status. Ideal for a thoughtful gift or a distinguished display, this piece offers a blend of function, history, and visual interest for any tobacco enthusiast or collector

Natural Raw Stone Crystal

As a natural geological formation, it embodies the organic beauty of metamorphic minerals, making it a compelling piece for collectors or as a decorative accent.

No synthetic treatments or artificial coatings applied

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
